item.title: Investigators say deadly midair collision near DC followed years of ignored warnings about traffic
item.description: National Transportation Safety Board members were deeply troubled Tuesday over years of ignored warnings about helicopter traffic dangers.

item.title: Liverpool specialists see rise in untreated hearing loss
item.description: Untreated hearing loss is on the rise among baby boomers, and providers are seeing an increase in new patients, with experts recommending that people get their hearing checked starting at age 40 to prevent years of frustration and health issues.

item.title: Advocates ask New York State to pay for food aid after federal cuts
item.description: A coalition of lawmakers and anti-hunger groups are urging New York Governor Kathy Hochul to add more money to the state budget to backfill federal budget cuts that threaten food security for hundreds of thousands of New Yorkers.

item.title: An inside look at Oneida High School after 7 months of flood repairs
item.description: After a summer storm caused extensive damage to Oneida City High School in June 2025, the school has been reopened and repaired with improved electrical and drainage systems, new flooring, and a new wiring system for the computers.

item.title: CNY SPCA protestors shocked and relieved by board's resignation
item.description: The CNY SPCA Board of Directors resigned after staff, volunteers, and community members protested for change due to issues with the shelter, including insufficient veterinary care, cruel conditions for animals, and overworked staff.
